explain.say: Think of a plant as a tiny team. Each part has its own job, just like players in a football team. Look at the plant on the board: flower, leaves, stem and roots. Let's meet each player, starting underground.

explain.say: See the roots glowing under the soil? Roots drink water and minerals, and they grip the ground so wind cannot knock the plant over. Have you ever tugged a weed and felt it hold on? That is the roots!

faq.a: Roots take in water and minerals from the soil and hold the plant firmly in the ground. Some roots, like carrots and cassava, also store food.
asks: What is the job of the roots?

faq.a: The stem holds the plant up towards the light and carries water up from the roots and food down from the leaves, through tiny tubes inside it.
asks: What is the job of the stem?

faq.a: Leaves catch sunlight with a green substance called chlorophyll. They use that light to turn water and carbon dioxide from the air into sugar, and give out oxygen.
asks: What is the job of a leaf?

faq.a: Flowers make seeds. Pollen, often carried by bees, butterflies or the wind, moves from flower to flower so seeds can form, and the seeds grow into new plants.
asks: What is the job of a flower?

faq.q: Which parts of plants do we eat?
faq.a: We eat every part! Carrots and cassava are roots, sugar cane and celery are stems, spinach and cabbage are leaves, broccoli and cauliflower are flowers, and rice, beans and peanuts are seeds.

facts: Water moves up a plant through tiny tubes called xylem.
A single rye plant grown in a box was found to have over 600 km of roots in total (Dittmer, 1937).

quiz.say: Which part of the plant drinks water from the soil?
quiz.show: Which part drinks water from the soil?
quiz.why: Roots take in water and minerals from the soil.

wrong.0: The flower makes seeds; it does not drink from the soil.
wrong.2: Leaves make food; water reaches them from the roots.

quiz.say: You eat a carrot. Which plant part are you eating?
quiz.why: A carrot is a root that stores food for the plant.

wrong.1: The stem of a carrot plant is the short green part with the leaves.
wrong.2: Carrot flowers are small and white, high above the ground.
